name: University of Bath
typicalOffer: AAB, including A in Biology and A in Chemistry
notes: 4-year BSc with mandatory 12-month industrial placement; Chemistry and Biology required; consistently one of the UK's best biochemistry placement programmes with AstraZeneca, Pfizer and GSK as partner employers

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: AAA-AAB, including grades AB in Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics and Mathematics (AAA if Chemistry is the only Core Science)
notes: 4-year MBiochem with optional placement year in biopharmaceutical or biotech company; Chemistry and Biology required; strong pharma industry links in Manchester

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: AAB-ABB, including chemistry and a second science from biology, physics, maths, further maths, statistics, psychology
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAA, including Chemistry and another science subject
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Warwick
typicalOffer: AAA, including Biology and Chemistry (alternative: A*AA including Chemistry and one of Mathematics, Physics or Statistics, plus GCSE Biology)
notes: 4-year MBiochem with optional research year abroad or industrial placement; Chemistry and Biology required; links to AstraZeneca and Merck through the Warwick Science Campus

name: University of York
typicalOffer: AAA, including grade A in Chemistry, plus a second science (Biology, Further Maths, Geology, Maths, PE, Physics or Statistics)
notes: 4-year MBiochem with industrial placement year; Chemistry and Biology required; York Science Park proximity enables frequent industry partnerships for placements

name: University of Southampton
typicalOffer: AAB, including Chemistry and one further science subject
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Sheffield
typicalOffer: AAB, including Chemistry and a second science
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Surrey
typicalOffer: ABB-BBB, Biology or Chemistry and a second science or mathematics subject
notes: 4-year BSc with mandatory 12-month placement year (a Surrey hallmark); Biology and Chemistry required; extremely strong placement record with AstraZeneca, Novartis and NHS diagnostic labs

name: University of Exeter
typicalOffer: ABB, B in Biology and B in Chemistry
notes: 4-year BSc with optional placement year in biotech or pharmaceutical sector; Chemistry required; links to Exeter Science Park and GSK's Barnard Castle site for placements
